title: Coverage End After a Repair Notice (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
Coverage of a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental under insurance or a warranty ends with the repair, according to the notice the repair sends.

## Notice schedule

| Notice from the repair | Coverage runs through |
|---|---|
| Vehicle ready | The class ready-notice grace, in business days after the notice date (Monday to Friday, excluding network holidays) |
| Total loss | The class total-loss coverage, in calendar days after the notice date |
| Repair cancelled | The notice date itself |

## Clauses

1. When an earlier authorization would run later, the notice still ends coverage; when authorized days run out first, coverage ends with them.
2. The clause under which every rental day starting after the coverage end date is the customer's at the partner rate is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
3. A single rental agreement runs at most the class's longest rental agreement in days before it is renewed at the branch.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, grace of one business day, total-loss coverage of three calendar days)

- Vehicle-ready notice dated on a Friday, the following Monday not a network holiday: coverage runs through that Monday. Were that Monday a network holiday, it runs through the Tuesday.
- Vehicle-ready notice dated on a Tuesday: coverage runs through the Wednesday.
- Total-loss notice dated on a Saturday: calendar days count every day, so coverage runs through the Tuesday.
- Repair-cancelled notice dated on a Wednesday: coverage ends on that Wednesday.
- Authorized days run out on the Monday while a vehicle-ready notice would carry coverage to the Thursday: coverage ends with the authorized days, on the Monday.

superseded_clauses: Every rental day starting after the coverage end date is the customer's at the partner rate.
